svg.text: 30 m, reprojected to the 10 m grid
• 256 px patches on a 64 px grid
S2 / S1 stems (1/2 scale) are reused by the refinement branch (2.4)
at each scale i: C_i(S2) ‖ C_i(S1) ‖ C_i(aux)
F1–F4 already have 256 ch, so the laterals are plain additions
concat S2 + S1 stems (64 + 64 ch, from 2.1)
Blend (1 − α) · flat + α · hierarchical, α = 1.0 → 6 × 256 × 256
+ per-class logit bias → argmax → label map 1 × 256 × 256
ordinal label smoothing ε = 0.1 · √-inverse class weights
Aux: same soft CE · 0.3 × (1/4 head) + 0.2 × (1/16 head)
Ordinal: BCE on soil pixels only · × 0.4
L = L_main + 0.3 L_aux,1/4 + 0.2 L_aux,1/16 + 0.4 L_coarse + 0.4 L_ord
• AdamW, weight decay 0.01 · OneCycle (5 % warm-up, cosine)
• LR 1e-4 for the ResNet-50s · 1e-3 for new layers
• EMA of weights (0.999) · BatchNorm statistics frozen
• best checkpoint by held-out macro-F1 (2 scenes)
• keep each window's centre → no seams
• α = 1.0 and per-class logit bias fitted
• never fitted on the test scenes
6 × H × W → label map 1 × H × W
BNPI scenes: 3600 × 5400 px · KNPI scenes: 2400 × 4800 px
Cloud and cloud-shadow pixels are ignored
in the loss and in evaluation.
1 × H × W per full scene (10 m pixels)
